# zone_dns_records (Data Source)

Reads the DNS records in a zone, optionally of one type.

Leaving `type` unset reads every type, which costs one API request per type. Since zone.eu allows 60 requests a minute, set `type` when only one kind is needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every record in the zone. Costs one API request per record type.
data "zone_dns_records" "all" {
  zone = "example.com"
}

# Just the A records, for one request.
data "zone_dns_records" "addresses" {
  zone = "example.com"
  type = "a"
}

# Records zone.eu manages itself and will not let you change.
output "locked_records" {
  value = [
    for record in data.zone_dns_records.all.records :
    "${record.type} ${record.name}" if !record.modifiable
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone to read, for example `example.com`.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the result to one record type: `a`, `aaaa`, `cname`, `ns`, `mx`, `txt`, `srv`, `caa`, `tlsa`, `sshfp` or `url`. All types are read when unset.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) The records found, sorted by type and then name. Attributes that do not apply to a record's type are null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (Number) SSHFP only.
- `certificate_usage` (Number) TLSA only.
- `comment` (String) Note attached by zone.eu.
- `deletable` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu allows this record to be removed.
- `destination` (String) Record value.
- `fingerprint_type` (Number) SSHFP only.
- `flag` (Number) CAA only.
- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by zone.eu.
- `matching_type` (Number) TLSA only.
- `modifiable` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu allows this record to be changed.
- `name` (String) Fully qualified record name.
- `port` (Number) SRV only.
- `priority` (Number) MX and SRV only.
- `redirect_code` (Number) URL redirects only.
- `resource_url` (String) API URL of this record.
- `selector` (Number) TLSA only.
- `tag` (String) CAA only.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `weight` (Number) SRV only.
